notes.title: New game mode: Dungeon crawling
notes.notes:
Version 0.9.0.2 - New game mode: Dungeon crawling

This version introduces a new game mode: Dungeon crawling.
Go straight to the pit, fight, loot, trade and go deeper and deeper into dungeons.
After finishing the game go to the next descent level (aka infinity gameplay), with better loot and stronger enemies.

Version 0.9.0.2 is an anniversary one!
To celebrate it there is a proper achievement added: Drink up
After one year of improvements, the game is certainly a better product.
I wanted to say 'Thank You' to all players who gave me valuable feedback allowing me to enhance the game.
Hope to deliver some new features this year, stay tuned!

notes.title: Oil surface, rain, thunders and more
notes.notes:
Want to enter the boss room? No problem but first find a proper key.
It would be inside a barrel, chest, grave or held by an enemy.
Sometimes it will be broken, sometimes there will be only a key mold available.

notes.title: Oil surface, rain, thunders and more
notes.notes:
Oil is a new kind of surface. You can find it in a natural form flowing from the ground or in barrels. No matter where it comes from you can use it to bake enemies.
Rain is falling from time to time, watch out for thunders!

notes.title: New Active Abilities
notes.notes:
Master new active abilities:

[list]
[*] Elemental Vengeance - adds Elemental (Fire, Poison and Cold) damage to melee attacks
[*] Cannon - brutal projectile attack
[*] Iron Skin - increases a defense statistic for a few turns
[*] Smoke - creates dense smoke around the hero making enemies confused
[/list]
